title: Three-Phase Balance Survey
description: Sequentially capture L1, L2, and L3 line-to-line voltages and evaluate phase voltage unbalance.

steps.title: Safety And Setup
steps.instruction: SAFETY: Three-phase systems are hazardous. Confirm PPE and CAT rating for the system voltage. Measure line-to-line at the same reference points for each pair. Keep both hands behind the barrier.
steps.note_prompt: Record panel/equipment ID and nominal system voltage.

steps.title: Measure L1-L2
steps.instruction: Set the meter to AC voltage. Measure line-to-line voltage between L1 and L2. Capture the reading.

acceptance.description: Sanity band for common 208 V / 240 V / 480 V three-phase systems.

steps.title: Measure L2-L3
steps.instruction: Measure line-to-line voltage between L2 and L3. Capture the reading.

steps.title: Measure L3-L1
steps.instruction: Measure line-to-line voltage between L3 and L1. Capture the reading. The survey then evaluates voltage unbalance across all three pairs.

acceptance.description: Voltage unbalance across the three line-to-line pairs must stay within 2% (NEMA MG-1 recommends under 1%; motors should be derated above ~2%).

steps.note_prompt: Note any phase that is high or low.

steps.title: Record Survey
steps.instruction: Document the unbalance result. Excessive voltage unbalance causes large current unbalance and motor overheating.
steps.note_prompt: Summarize corrective actions if unbalance is high.
